question: Which direction points toward the closest golf course relative to E.O. Wilson Biophilia Center, Freeport, FL?
sql:
SELECT *, degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-86.054207 30.476436)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) AS angle  FROM pois
WHERE leisure = 'golf_course'
ORDER BY geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-86.054207 30.476436)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: E.O. Wilson Biophilia Center, Freeport, FL
